'''Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi''' ([[Russian language|Russian]]: Сергей Иосифович Божевольный, born June 19, 1955) is a Russian-Danish physicist. He is currently a professor and the leader for the Centre for Nano Optics at the [[University of Southern Denmark]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sdu.dk:443/en/om_sdu/institutter_centre/nanooptics|title=SDU Nano Optics|website=SDU}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Bozhevolnyi was raised in the village of Kopanskaya, [[Yeysky District]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[USSR]] and grew up in a family of teachers of physics and mathematics. In 1978 he graduated from [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]] with a Master of Science degree in physics. In 1981, he earned a PhD-degree from the same university with the thesis entitled "Study of electro-optical modulators and deflectors based on diffuse waveguides in LiNbO₃". In 1998, he earned a Doctor of Science Degree at [[Aarhus University]], [[Denmark]], with his thesis entitled "Subwavelength apertureless light confinement".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://findresearcher.sdu.dk/portal/da/persons/sergey-i-bozhevolnyi(9df17db0-2e69-41ff-8a38-8738093f0385)/cv.html?id=143646776|title=Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi
|website= University of Southern Denmark}}</ref>

* 1981–1989 Lecturer, Senior Lecturer, Associate Professor of the {{ill|Yaroslavl State Technical University|ru|Ярославский государственный технический университет|vertical-align=sup}}, Russia
* 1990–1991 Head of Section of Optical Technologies, Institute of Microelectronics, Russian Academy of Sciences, Yaroslavl, Russia
* 1987, 1991 — visiting scientist, since 1992 lecturer and associate professor, since 2003 full professor at the Department of Physics and Nanotechnology, [[Aalborg University]], Denmark
* 1998–2001 Lecturer at the Center for Microelectronics, [[Technical University of Denmark]], Denmark
* 2001–2004 Chief Technical Officer, Micro Managed Photons A / S, Denmark
* since 2008 Professor of nano-optics, since 2013 head of the Center for Nano Optics at the University of Southern Denmark, [[Odense]], Denmark

In 2006, together with professor Alexander Tishchenko at [[Jean Monnet University]], he founded the Laboratory of Nano-Optics and Plasmonics in [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mipt.ru/en/science/labs/nano/|title=Laboratory of Nanooptics and Plasmonics — MIPT|website=mipt.ru}}</ref>

Since 2017, Bozhevolnyi is on the list of the most Highly Cited Researchers ( Clarivate / Thomson-Reuters<ref>{{cite web|url=https://hcr.clarivate.com/|title=Highly Cited Researchers – The Most Influential Scientific Minds|website=HCR|access-date=2019-02-25|archive-date=2019-02-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190220122703/https://hcr.clarivate.com/|url-status=dead}}</ref>).

==Publications==
Professor Bozhevolnyi has authored and co-authored more than 600 peer-reviewed articles with 15 patents and 14 book chapters.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.dk/citations?user=nfUOZNgAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao|title=Publications of Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi|website = Google Scholar}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.worldcat.org/search?q=au:Bozhevolnyi,+Sergey+I.,&qt=hot_author|title=Books of Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi|website=Worldcat}}</ref> His [[h-index]] was 88 ([https://publons.com/researcher/2784485/sergey-i-bozhevolnyi/ Web of Science]) and 105 ([https://scholar.google.com.sg/citations?user=nfUOZNgAAAAJ&hl=en Google Scholar]) as of April 3, 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.expertcorps.org/science/whoiswho/by_branch/phys?sortby=h|title=Corpus expertov|website=www.expertcorps.org}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 2007 Elected Fellow of the [[Optical Society|Optical Society of America]] for his "pioneering contributions to near-field optics and plasmonics, including nonlinear phenomena and surface plasmon localization and guiding in nanostructures."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.osa.org/en-us/awards_and_grants/fellow_members/recent_fellows/2007_fellows/|title=2007 OSA Fellows
|website = www.osa.org}}</ref>

* 2009 Best Scientist of the year from the Danish newspaper "Fyens Stiftstidendes Forskerpris"<ref>{{cite web|url=http://findresearcher.sdu.dk/portal/da/prizes/fyens-stiftstidende-forskerpris-2009(62b27560-87d5-11de-be4e-000ea68e967b).html|title=Fyens Stiftstidende Forskerpris 2009 – Syddansk Universitet|website=findresearcher.sdu.dk}}</ref>
* 2011 Selected as a member of the Danish Academy of Natural Sciences (DNA)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.danaak.dk/home|title=Danmarks Naturvidenskabelige Akademi|website=www.danaak.dk|access-date=2019-02-25|archive-date=2019-03-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190317175803/http://www.danaak.dk/home|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2019 Willum Kann-Rasmussen Prize (for outstanding contributions to the development of technical and natural sciences)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sdu.dk:443/en/om_sdu/fakulteterne/teknik/nyt_fra_det_tekniske_fakultet/sergey+bozhevolnyi+modtager+villum+kann+rasmussens+aarslegat|title=Sergey Bozhevolnyi modtager villum kann rasmussens aarslegat|website=SDU}}</ref>
* 2019 Danish Optical Society Senior Award (for outstanding contribution to near-field optics and fundamental efforts in the development of nano-optics in Denmark, 2019)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://dops.dk/conference/annual2019.htm|title=DOPS annual conference 2019 – Danish Optical Society|publisher=|access-date=2019-02-25|archive-date=2021-12-31|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211231161312/http://dops.dk/conference/annual2019.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2019 Selected as a member of the Danish Academy of Technical Sciences (ATV)
* 2020 [https://www.cleoeurope.org/eps-qeod-prizes/ Recipient of the EPS-QEOD Prize for "Research in Laser Science and Applications" (for seminal contributions to surface-plasmon polaritons and the developments of plasmonic metasurfaces)]
* 2024 Knighted in [[Order of the Dannebrog]] by His Majesty the King on October 23, 2024<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kongehuset.dk/monarkiet-i-danmark/ordener-og-medaljer/modtagere-af-danske-dekorationer#|title=Modtagere af danske dekorationer}}</ref>
